coverage.authority_label: The host rows carry the Bank of Thailand financial-institution closure list, the only gazetted 2027 closure calendar retrieved; the Cabinet public-holiday calendar was not retrieved on 2026-11-25 and remains subject to announcement.

evidence.note: Islamic dates are marked subject to the Chularatchamontri announcement. The Cabinet Secretariat public-holiday page returned 403 to the research user agent and its indexed page is the 2569 list, so no 2027 Cabinet date is stored.
evidence.observed_facts: The 2027 list covers the whole year with 18 closures including the Songkran span of 13-15 April. This is the financial-institution closure list under the Financial Institution Business Act; the Cabinet's official public-holiday calendar for 2027 was not retrieved on 2026-11-25, so the layer is labelled financial-institution closures and the public-holiday calendar remains subject to announcement. Islamic observance closures are limited to the Islamic Bank of Thailand and branches in Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, Satun and Songkhla and follow the Chularatchamontri announcement, so they are not Bangkok-wide rows.

translation_review.gloss: The notice sets the traditional closure days for financial institutions and specialised financial institutions for 2027, and adds Eid closures for the Islamic Bank of Thailand and for branches in five southern provinces.
translation_review.review: Thailand publishes one national public-holiday list; Bangkok has no separate public holiday of its own, so this host row carries the national list rather than inventing a city-specific one. The Royal Ploughing Ceremony is not in the Bank of Thailand list because banks stay open for it, so its 2027 date remains subject to announcement.

holidays.authority_label: Date derived from the parenthetical in Bank of Thailand notice 37/2569; the Buddhist lunar observance date is subject to the official announcement.

evidence.note: Buddhist lunar observance: the day is fixed by the official announcement and the reported date is subject to confirmation against it. The PDF text layer encodes the Thai vowel mark U+0E4C as U+F70E in this word, so the stored quote carries that byte; the gloss gives the intended reading.
evidence.observed_facts: The notice prints the substitute closure next to the parenthetical '21 กุมภาพันธ', which names the actual observance day.
